newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania UAMT rejoins bourse after split.
newsitem.headline: Romania UAMT rejoins bourse after split.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said listed vehicles part manufacturer UAMT would rejoin the market on Wednesday after a three-session suspension pending a split of its shares.
A bourse statement said UAMT had had to lower the nominal value of its shares to 1,000 lei from 25,000 each to meet all bids under a mass sell-off oversubscription.

UAMT has a share capital of 22.6 billion lei. It was part of a mass sell-off which Romania launched late in 1995, offering some 15 million Romanians stakes of up to 60 percent in around 4,000 state companies in exchange for coupons.
To avoid coexistence on the bourse of shares of the same company at two different nominal values, the 25,000 lei shares were split, with one 25,000 lei share divided into 25 shares of 1,000 lei each.

The market price of the new UAMT shares will be decided by the play of demand and offer during the exchange's trading session on Wednesday, the statement said. The new UAMT market price will become reference price for the following session.
When it last traded, UAMT closed at 12,500 lei, compared to 25,000 lei at par.
